content.title: Dely Brahim Mixed-Use Tower — 240 Apartments
summary: A 33-storey mixed-use tower in the Bois des Cars district of Dely Brahim, Algiers, integrating 240 market-rate apartments with a three-level commercial podium and six levels of parking.
The tower brings together residential, retail, and parking functions within a single vertical structure — with apartments from the 3rd to the 33rd floor, eight units per floor.
description: F3, F4, and F5 apartment typologies are distributed from the 3rd to the 33rd floor, with eight units per level. The three-level commercial base provides active street frontage, while three basement levels and three parking mezzanines resolve vehicle circulation within the plot.
The structural execution required precise vertical coordination across reinforced concrete framing, circulation shafts, fire compartmentation, building services systems, and facade articulation.
content.authority: A high-rise mixed-use development coordinating residential density, active street-level commercial frontage, and multi-level parking within a single structural frame.

faq.question: What does the Dely Brahim Mixed-Use Tower include?
faq.answer: A 33-storey tower containing 240 market-rate apartments, a three-level commercial podium, three basement levels, and three parking mezzanines.

faq.question: How are the residential and commercial zones distributed?
faq.answer: F3, F4, and F5 apartments occupy the 3rd to 33rd floors, with eight units per level. The three commercial levels sit beneath, providing active street-level frontage.

faq.question: What parking infrastructure is integrated into the project?
faq.answer: Six levels of parking are integrated into the structure: three basement levels and three parking mezzanine floors, resolving all vehicle circulation within the building footprint.
